This carousel format is SUCH an easy way to get people interacting with your post because they instantly want to see how many fingers they end up putting down. ✋

And the best part? You can make the statements funny, relatable, salesy, educational…whatever fits your brand. ✨

A few examples:

SOCIAL MEDIA COACH
Put a finger down if…

* you open Instagram and have no idea what to post
* you save content ideas and never use them
* you disappear every time business gets busy
* you’re getting views but not enough sales

ESTHETICIAN
Put a finger down if…

* your skin always feels dry
* you keep buying random skincare
* you’ve been saying “I need a facial” for months
* you have products you don’t even know how to use

BOUTIQUE
Put a finger down if…

* you say “I have nothing to wear” every week
* you own 5 versions of the same black top
* you buy cute pieces but never know how to style them
* you’re already thinking about your next outfit

HAIRSTYLIST
Put a finger down if…

* you’ve used box dye “just this once”
* you’ve cut your own bangs
* you’ve gone way too long between appointments
* you’ve shown your stylist a Pinterest photo and said “this please” 😂

If you put down 3+ fingers… this is probably your sign. 😉

This rock paper scissors trend is literally all over instagram right now ☺️

The easiest way to write yours is:

Scissors = what they’re doing without you.
Rock = your offer, service or solution.

And because rock wins every time…Your post basically makes the point for you. ☺️

For a hair salon:

Scissors:
“Box dye at 11 p.m.”

Rock:
“Booking a color appointment.”

We all know how that story ends. 😅

Number three: the “I’ll do it later” version.

Here, scissors is waiting too long.

Rock is doing the smart thing now.

For a wedding florist:

Scissors:
“Booking your flowers 8 weeks before the wedding.”

Rock:
“Booking your florist a year in advance.”

And number four: the rabbit-hole version.

Scissors is where your customer is currently getting free advice.

And rock is getting actual help from someone who understands their specific situation.

So if you’re a personal trainer:

Scissors:
“Following a random TikTok workout plan.”

Rock:
“Following a plan actually built for your body + goals.”
 
Are you posting this for this business? ☺️

#rockpaperscissors #rockpaperscissortrend #trendingpost #trendypost #instagramtrend

The easiest way to write yours is:

Scissors = what they’re doing without you.
Rock = your offer, service or solution.

And because rock wins every time…Your post basically makes the point for you. ☺️

For a hair salon:

Scissors:
“Box dye at 11 p.m.”

Rock:
“Booking a color appointment.”

We all know how that story ends. 😅

Number three: the “I’ll do it later” version.

Here, scissors is waiting too long.

Rock is doing the smart thing now.

For a wedding florist:

Scissors:
“Booking your flowers 8 weeks before the wedding.”

Rock:
“Booking your florist a year in advance.”

And number four: the rabbit-hole version.

Scissors is where your customer is currently getting free advice.

And rock is getting actual help from someone who understands their specific situation.

So if you’re a personal trainer:

Scissors:
“Following a random TikTok workout plan.”

Rock:
“Following a plan actually built for your body + goals.”
 
Are you posting this for this business? ☺️
